purpose: 프론트 담당자와 코딩 AI가 실행되는 실제 API 연결 화면을 인수하고 UI를 개선하기 위한 시작 정보

stack.frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + React Router + CSS Modules
stack.transport: MQTT 5 to backend; same-origin REST and SSE to browser

invariants: No browser connection to MQTT or PostgreSQL; no fake API replacement.
Keep CSRF, session handling, aborts, and role/zone authorization; no tokens in browser storage.
Accept initial revision zero, then strictly increasing revision; close old stream on route/account change.
snapshot=null means no observation, not an empty zone. Device connectivity, camera state and UI transport are distinct.
Events alone do not make device ONLINE. Valid heartbeat: over 15 seconds STALE, over 30 seconds OFFLINE.
Event history refreshes through REST even if the zone revision does not change.
SSE sends committed full snapshots every second, coalesces intermediate revisions, and is not an audit log.
Keep virtual-device labels. Reported stopping duration is simulated and must not be called real AI inference.
Keep v1.43 originals unchanged; use effective contracts and documented ADR changes.
git_workflow: Create a work branch from feat/frontend-handoff and target PR to that branch until parent PRs merge; main is not yet the handoff code.
not_implemented: real board SDK and AI inference
external_inputs: frontend collaborator GitHub ID and recipient acceptance
do_not_claim: large-scale capacity or zero host-loss data loss
access: Anonymous read/clone; direct push needs collaborator permission or contribute through a fork/PR.
